c203ad04dec2d21841bcc18d917b597ee0cbdde3.differentia: consists of a string of characters that designates an entity within a specified cultural or social namespace and that is typically a word or phrase in a natural language having accepted cultural or social significance
c203ad04dec2d21841bcc18d917b597ee0cbdde3.enriched_definition: A designative name is a designative information content entity that consists of a string of characters that designates an entity within a specified cultural or social namespace and that is typically a word or phrase in a natural language having accepted cultural or social significance.

1181e256c55ea97981dad4cd11c9fe675ad64d8e.differentia: is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to either the middle value or the average of the two values that separate the set into two equally populated upper and lower sets
1181e256c55ea97981dad4cd11c9fe675ad64d8e.enriched_definition: A median point estimate information content entity is a point estimate information content entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to either the middle value or the average of the two values that separate the set into two equally populated upper and lower sets.

6757271670b10da8b34ae3e0ef69441ea21c5b19.differentia: is a statutory time scale that is designated by civil authorities to determine local time(s)
6757271670b10da8b34ae3e0ef69441ea21c5b19.enriched_definition: A civil time reference system is a temporal reference system that is a statutory time scale designated by civil authorities to determine local time(s).

72064c7739252e8ad3a07e06720922c30b2823f1.enriched_definition: A temporal interval identifier is a temporal region identifier that designates some temporal interval.

8221ffcd73b3e59cd4e90da7265e7da0f045e2f9.differentia: consists of a string of characters that was created and assigned according to an encoding system such that metadata can be derived from the identifier
8221ffcd73b3e59cd4e90da7265e7da0f045e2f9.enriched_definition: A code identifier is a non-name identifier that consists of a string of characters that was created and assigned according to an encoding system such that metadata can be derived from the identifier.

de4fba25f9143aa504b7c9fc5e340149102f16ae.differentia: designates a temporal instant that is part of some day and is specified using the hours, minutes, and seconds of that day elapsed up to the temporal instant
de4fba25f9143aa504b7c9fc5e340149102f16ae.enriched_definition: A standard time of day identifier is a time of day identifier that designates a temporal instant that is part of some day and is specified using the hours, minutes, and seconds of that day elapsed up to the temporal instant.

9524d0a4dcc1cebbe894bbc2769cb7bf4ae83bf9.differentia: designates some day by using an ordinal number to indicate the sequential position of the day within a year
9524d0a4dcc1cebbe894bbc2769cb7bf4ae83bf9.enriched_definition: An ordinal date identifier is a decimal date identifier that designates some day by using an ordinal number to indicate the sequential position of the day within a year.

0cff5f57b8c4d159c440f84ad35167cd414efd67.differentia: is about a definite magnitude of a physical quantity that is defined and adopted by convention and/or by law and is used as a standard for measurement of the same physical quantity
0cff5f57b8c4d159c440f84ad35167cd414efd67.enriched_definition: A measurement unit is a descriptive information content entity that is about a definite magnitude of a physical quantity that is defined and adopted by convention and/or by law and is used as a standard for measurement of the same physical quantity.

96c4a9e092469293d37a17ba7337851999b1a1ac.differentia: is based on the apparent position of the Sun in the sky
96c4a9e092469293d37a17ba7337851999b1a1ac.enriched_definition: A solar time reference system is a temporal reference system that is based on the apparent position of the Sun in the sky.

2f17a232434c431a47d1e10ee874f213510dfb50.differentia: is about a process participant's behavior under one or more specified operating conditions and prescribes some aspect of that behavior
2f17a232434c431a47d1e10ee874f213510dfb50.enriched_definition: A performance specification is a prescriptive information content entity that is about some aspect of the behavior of a participant in a process given one or more operating conditions.

c32dce6ea4a35cc3fed90f5e18c1796fdaf61f6a.differentia: that is designed through deliberate planning and premeditation rather than developed through natural use and repetition over time
c32dce6ea4a35cc3fed90f5e18c1796fdaf61f6a.enriched_definition: A artificial language is a language that is designed through deliberate planning and premeditation rather than developed through natural use and repetition over time.

6f65e2819f2d2266191d97e065bc4682ecc0e4b4.differentia: is about a set of values and is equal to the value or values that occur most often in that set
6f65e2819f2d2266191d97e065bc4682ecc0e4b4.enriched_definition: A mode point estimate information content entity is a point estimate information content entity that is about a set of values and is equal to the value or values that occur most often in that set.

b495a4e8462901e1c17929e950036989762d78a0.differentia: is an ordinal measurement information content entity that is about some entity in virtue of that entity having the least amount relative to a nominally described set of like entities
b495a4e8462901e1c17929e950036989762d78a0.enriched_definition: A minimum ordinal measurement information content entity is a ordinal measurement information content entity that is about some entity in virtue of that entity having the least amount relative to a nominally described set of like entities.

1c4c68bf57f8a3153c5a5dd0d4ffcf50b96661b7.differentia: is about the ordinal position of a version of a material artifact relative to other forms of that material artifact, where the form differs in some respects from previous or future forms of that material artifact
1c4c68bf57f8a3153c5a5dd0d4ffcf50b96661b7.enriched_definition: An artifact version ordinality is an ordinal measurement information content entity that is about the ordinal position of a version of a material artifact relative to other forms of that material artifact, where the form differs in some respects from previous or future forms of that material artifact.

079a374f659ea9bcef7837bcb3f1614f00472c63.differentia: is about a process and designates the current state of that process as one of a set of nominal categories
079a374f659ea9bcef7837bcb3f1614f00472c63.enriched_definition: An event status nominal information content entity is a nominal measurement information content entity that is about a process and designates the current state of that process as one of a set of nominal categories.

c4ef84b2f056021a2f2ee3fb75f822868a43f1d8.differentia: that generically depends on an information content entity
c4ef84b2f056021a2f2ee3fb75f822868a43f1d8.enriched_definition: An information bearing entity is an object that generically depends on an information content entity.

a60420c40467eab4f1726434b7b16c49ffe559c6.differentia: that is a convention for keeping and displaying the time of day
a60420c40467eab4f1726434b7b16c49ffe559c6.enriched_definition: A clock time system is a temporal reference system that is a convention for keeping and displaying the time of day.

eb7b18d5e23b51e96cbccdb10a6b33e303a9ef4d.differentia: describes a set of standards for uniquely identifying the position of an entity or the direction of a vector within a defined spatial region by means of measurements along one or more coordinate system axes
eb7b18d5e23b51e96cbccdb10a6b33e303a9ef4d.enriched_definition: A spatial reference system is a reference system that describes a set of standards for uniquely identifying the position of an entity or the direction of a vector within a defined spatial region by means of measurements along one or more coordinate system axes.

d4271eebb0e99a1d035d95d4c7d0d6ef867ee4cf.differentia: that is designed to organize and identify dates based on the cycles of an astronomical body's orbit around the Sun
d4271eebb0e99a1d035d95d4c7d0d6ef867ee4cf.enriched_definition: A solar calendar system is a calendar system that is designed to organize and identify dates based on the cycles of an astronomical body's orbit around the Sun.

d6dc1efe66931e9b29aa8ff286475f82adbe3620.differentia: consists of a symbol that is about a classification of entities according to some shared, possibly arbitrary, characteristic
d6dc1efe66931e9b29aa8ff286475f82adbe3620.enriched_definition: A nominal measurement information content entity is a measurement information content entity that consists of a symbol that is about a classification of entities according to some shared, possibly arbitrary, characteristic.

1028a34723d32c74433223a4dcba5f260647b933.differentia: that is concretized by some information content entity
1028a34723d32c74433223a4dcba5f260647b933.enriched_definition: An information quality entity is a quality that is concretized by some information content entity.

2a8c25a02ce1216c24f4a95a62f9aaf73b619649.differentia: is about a relative importance of an entity
2a8c25a02ce1216c24f4a95a62f9aaf73b619649.enriched_definition: A priority measurement information content entity is a ordinal measurement information content entity that is about a relative importance of an entity.

a6fa3635a99057ba34c521275e4d7b0ec1e6c499.enriched_definition: A spatial region identifier is a designative information content entity that designates some spatial region.

28785a044a59c306f145eb4589a87e9837fe4839.differentia: is about a set of standards for organizing and understanding data of a specified type or domain
28785a044a59c306f145eb4589a87e9837fe4839.enriched_definition: A reference system is a descriptive information content entity that is about a set of standards for organizing and understanding data of a specified type or domain.

8ea6c33155bf2dae098d4698f9448fef7ce60d9d.enriched_definition: A temporal region identifier is a designative information content entity that designates some temporal region.

c4867dbbd3bb69e39bc95b33bffc0b125fdb8f66.differentia: that is used to express the value of a geocoordinate measurement, a geospatial coordinate that is about a location
c4867dbbd3bb69e39bc95b33bffc0b125fdb8f66.enriched_definition: A measurement unit of geocoordinate is a measurement unit that is used to express the value of a geospatial coordinate that is about a location.

8b4bd78b099e1cd93040a2f6db0f26a4782a5f59.differentia: designates a type of part whose instances are designed to be part of some material artifact
8b4bd78b099e1cd93040a2f6db0f26a4782a5f59.enriched_definition: A part number is a code identifier that designates a type of part whose instances are designed to be part of some material artifact.

d295be3dbb0664f3d392294e0e7c9ee74983a95e.differentia: is used to determine and identify the location of a point or object at or near the surface of the Earth
d295be3dbb0664f3d392294e0e7c9ee74983a95e.enriched_definition: A geospatial coordinate reference system is a spatial reference system that is used to determine and identify the location of a point or object at or near the surface of the Earth.

276d5a1020f8ae6093e1556f57329cd279c835da.differentia: that is developed and evolves through use and repetition rather than through conscious planning or premeditation
276d5a1020f8ae6093e1556f57329cd279c835da.enriched_definition: A natural language is a language that is developed and evolves through use and repetition rather than through conscious planning or premeditation.

9f636c89574975fc9f1aa72e89997d492243a702.enriched_definition: A date identifier is a temporal interval identifier that designates some day.

75bd172619d16ef2de5b3fbce4559b243e21f742.differentia: is about a measurement of the number of members of some aggregate
75bd172619d16ef2de5b3fbce4559b243e21f742.enriched_definition: A count measurement information content entity is a ratio measurement information content entity that is about a measurement of the number of members of some aggregate.

7b7bef83a035d52bb9c840825b2c051fba534e52.enriched_definition: A temporal instant identifier is a temporal region identifier that designates some temporal instant.

1e67a3aff60f0f8e9cddf04274a66ce470fa414f.differentia: designates an approximate temporal instant that is part of some julian day
1e67a3aff60f0f8e9cddf04274a66ce470fa414f.enriched_definition: A julian date fraction is a decimal time of day identifier that designates an approximate temporal instant that is part of some julian day.

4e46543c6e1118b0028a3697b7096974373b796c.differentia: is about the extent to which a description conforms to the reality it describes
4e46543c6e1118b0028a3697b7096974373b796c.enriched_definition: A veracity measurement information content entity is a measurement information content entity that is about the extent to which a description conforms to the reality it describes.

92005248e234cbda79e7308a7d6b4bdbdec39b5a.differentia: is about some entity and designates that entity as having the greatest amount of a measured quantity relative to a set of like entities described nominally
92005248e234cbda79e7308a7d6b4bdbdec39b5a.enriched_definition: A maximum ordinal measurement information content entity is an ordinal measurement information content entity that is about some entity and designates that entity as having the greatest amount of a measured quantity relative to a nominally described set of like entities.

926f0669c87017fbc89ac88b6e8b5e507539c775.differentia: is about a Proper Name and is a shortened form of that Proper Name
926f0669c87017fbc89ac88b6e8b5e507539c775.enriched_definition: A abbreviated name is a designative name that is about a proper name and is a shortened form of that proper name.

9bc510f9688b5d7b27394055e07beeb52a2f4ea3.differentia: is about an uncertain future event
9bc510f9688b5d7b27394055e07beeb52a2f4ea3.enriched_definition: A predictive information content entity is a descriptive information content entity that is about an uncertain future event.
